examples.arabic: نشرب الشاي الحار معا ونتكلم بسعادة تحت النجوم
examples.english: We drink hot tea together and talk happily under the stars.
examples.transliteration: nashrabu ash-shay al-harr maan wa-natakallamu bisaada tahta an-nujum.

examples.english: We drink hot tea with the seller.

examples.arabic: نجلس في غرفة الجلوس ونشرب الشاي
examples.english: We sit in the living room and drink tea.
examples.transliteration: najlisu fi ghurfat al julus wa nashrabu al shay
examples.storyTitle: A Visit to My Grandfather's House

examples.english: I drink a cup of tea now.
I am watching TV and drinking tea.
examples.transliteration: Ana ushahid al-tilfaz wa ashrab ash-shay.

examples.arabic: عرض علي كوبا من الشاي الساخن كعادة اهل السوق
examples.english: He offered me a cup of hot tea, as is the custom of the market people
examples.transliteration: 'Arada 'alayya kooban min ash-shaayi as-saakhin ka-'aadati ahli as-sooq
examples.storyTitle: A Visit to the Local Market
